name: Mona Malicevic
abstract_title:
Olfactory Modulation of Fear Circuits and the Neurobiology of Grounding:

How Scent-Based Inputs Rapidly Influence Safety Signaling in the Limbic System
abstract: Olfaction is the only sensory pathway with direct projections to the amygdala and hippocampus, allowing scent-based inputs to influence emotional states before conscious processing occurs. This unique architecture gives olfactory cues the capacity to rapidly modulate fear circuitry, autonomic arousal, and the body’s implicit evaluation of safety.
